Hopeful early summer news for anyone travelling with a pet
The talk of the desk is lively

Fresh paws, calm plans

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways is keeping things steady and warm, and we are sorry for the bustle some travelers have faced. Staff are nudging each trip toward comfort, with the senior coordinator making the day-to-day calls and the safety coordinator watching for hazards. Here at the counter, <<FACT F020>> and the team keeps sharing plain guidance with crews.

We are also hearing good things from the quarantine side, and it helps to know the care plans are shaped around each animal's species, temperament, and comfort. <<FACT F029>> Thanks for your patience while we keep pet travel as smooth as we can. Companion Animal Travel Desk
